sequences.title: Lease time across a DHCP exchange

intro.quote: This option is used in a client request (DHCPDISCOVER or DHCPREQUEST) to allow the client to request a lease time for the IP address. In a server reply (DHCPOFFER), a DHCP server uses this option to specify the lease time it is willing to offer.

steps.explain: The client asks for a lease duration in its discovery request.

intro.quote: DHCP options have the same format as the BOOTP 'vendor extensions' defined in RFC 1497 [2].

fields.name: Magic cookie
fields.explain: The cookie identifies how the succeeding vendor information should be interpreted.

cite.quote: When used with BOOTP, the first four octets of the vendor information field have been assigned to the "magic cookie" (as suggested in RFC 951). This field identifies the mode in which the succeeding data is to be interpreted.

fields.name: Vendor extensions
fields.explain: This variable area carries the BOOTP vendor extensions, whose format is the same as DHCP options.

cite.quote: DHCP options have the same format as the BOOTP 'vendor extensions' defined in RFC 1497 [2].

intro.quote: Options may be fixed length or variable length. All options begin with a tag octet, which uniquely identifies the option. Fixed-length options without data consist of only a tag octet. Only options 0 and 255 are fixed length. All other options are variable-length with a length octet following the tag octet.

fields.name: Code
fields.explain: The code identifies the option. A range of codes is reserved for site-specific options.

cite.quote: Option codes 128 to 254 (decimal) are reserved for site-specific options.

fields.name: Len
fields.explain: The length gives the size of the data without counting the tag and length octets.

cite.quote: The value of the length octet does not include the two octets specifying the tag and length.

fields.name: Data
fields.explain: The data follows the length octet, whose value gives the number of data octets.

cite.quote: The length octet is followed by "length" octets of data.
